# Stratus Event Center

> Premier corporate event venue and concert hall in Phoenix, Arizona (also known as Club Stratus). A large, modern, fully-staffed indoor music hall with capacity for up to 2,250 guests, specializing in corporate events, corporate productions, live music, concerts, nightlife and live entertainment, with full-service catering. Serving the Phoenix metro: Phoenix, Glendale, Scottsdale, Peoria, Avondale, Surprise and Litchfield Park.

## Key facts
- Address: 4344 W Indian School Rd, Ste 32, Phoenix, AZ 85031 (just off Indian School Rd, minutes from the I-10 and Loop 101)
- Phone (call or text): (602) 908-7817
- Email: Stratuseventcenteraz@gmail.com
- Tours: by appointment, 7 days a week
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/stratuseventcenteraz/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/StratusEventCenter/

## What the venue offers
- One of the larger indoor event venues in Phoenix: up to 2,250 guests
- Flexible main hall that scales from intimate seated dinners to large-scale concerts
- Live entertainment programming: comedy nights, magic shows, boxing matches, wrestling nights and touring acts
- Built-in stage and dance floor
- In-house professional sound and programmable lighting
- Authentic Mexican catering done in-house, plus a licensed bar; the venue also works with any outside food vendor a client prefers
- DJs, bandas and mariachi bands booked directly through the venue for corporate and private events
- Busing and shuttle transportation for corporate groups, arranged through the venue
- Experiences are customizable end to end (decor, entertainment, menus, transport), priced per quote and request
- Professional on-site security at every event
- On-site lit parking
- VIP tables: reserved couch sections front and center of the stage ($200 table for 4, $300 table for 6, $400 VIP table for 8 to 10)
- Signature themed corporate events (Hawaiian luau, Mini Mexico, Wild West and custom themes) with full catering for up to 2,000 guests

- Live event calendar (Club Stratus): https://www.bandsintown.com/v/10168441-club-stratus
- Official ticket sellers: Bandsintown, Ticketón, Tickeri, Ticketmaster (https://www.ticketmaster.com/stratus-event-center-boletos-phoenix/venue/205291)
- Verified resale: https://www.stubhub.com/stratus-event-center-tickets/venue/102133143/
- Typical programming: norteño, reggaetón, duranguense and other Latin concerts, plus private events
